title: DF-Story Teller
description: An AI storytelling tool for Dwarf Fortress. Uses Legends data, live events and DFHack to generate stories based on your world.

title: AI Game Assistant
description: A voice-controlled game assistant that uses OCR and save-file analysis to answer questions about in-game lore while avoiding spoilers.

title: DF-Portrait
description: A standalone portrait tool that recreates Dwarf Fortress characters from DFHack data. Originally part of DF-Story Teller, now open source.

title: Home Assistant + Cloudflare
description: My Home Assistant setup, accessed remotely through a Cloudflare Tunnel with Zero Trust access controls.

title: Personal Portfolio
description: This website. Built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and hosted on GitHub Pages. Previously self-hosted through a Cloudflare Tunnel.
